headline: Philips launches fixed-room coronary imaging system in U.S.
summary: Royal Philips has launched a new fixed-room coronary imaging system in the United States, expanding its medical technology offerings for cardiovascular procedures.
why: Royal Philips is a major global health technology company specializing in diagnostic imaging, image-guided therapy, and patient monitoring systems.

impacts.why: Launch of a new medical imaging product in the US market.
